svg.title: The ranking of search strategies reverses when the action space is corrected
svg.desc: A slope chart. Each of four search strategies is plotted by its distance from the brute-force optimum on the original three-number action space (left) and on the per-stage nine-number action space (right). Bayesian optimisation moves from best to worst; A2C and PPO move from the middle to joint best.

g.text: 3 numbers · one dataflow for the whole workload
9 numbers · one dataflow per attention stage

text.tspan: A2C and PPO are statistically indistinguishable, so A2C — the method the project originally specified — is retained
for every later experiment. Bayesian optimisation's early lead did not survive the redesign.
